## Checklist

- [ ] `npm run check` passes, and `dist/` is rebuilt and committed with the change
- [ ] A `dist/` change raises `package.json`'s version (patch for a fix, minor for a feature)
- [ ] Docs updated where behaviour changed (README, docs/, GLOSSARY.md)
- [ ] No names of people or rooms, house names, hostnames, IP addresses or emails in files, commits or this description
